title: MixedStone Duo #034 · 여 커브드 바스트·TurkishGlam·석재 말라카이트 / 남 클래식 머슬·아이돌 내추럴·신소재 용암
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright bamboo grove with a smooth stone path, tall green bamboo on both sides, a waist-high bamboo fence and a standard gate, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Turkish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (an iron small flared temple bell, a copper chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin round bell, a lead square-sided cowbell, a gold cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a gold miniature anvil, a lead teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered mixed-metal bracelets. Extra long nails in matching polished malachite.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body polished banded malachite fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep emerald-green malachite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale-green concentric banding swirling through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved banded malachite.

LEFT Cracks: the banded malachite body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left shoulder, and one chipped-off piece at her right hip, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw dark-green stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the banded malachite is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: one hand resting on her hip, the other hanging relaxed at her side, weight on one leg.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme ankle-strap platform stiletto pumps in glossy black patent leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved banded malachite right down to the shoes.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Lebanese man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, smooth olive-tan skin, a confident smirk, cool ash-brown hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a silver barrel-shaped weight, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold hair ornaments. Extra long nails in matching polished lava rock.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body cooled black lava rock fused directly to his own form wrapping his whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid lava rock curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted lava rock sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING rough matte-black volcanic rock surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID glowing orange-red molten fissures running between every section, rough volcanic-textured, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. His face and ears are real living skin, and his neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and his shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved cooled black lava rock.

RIGHT Cracks: the cooled black lava rock body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across his left calf, and one chipped-off piece at his right forearm, where the broken edge reveals the raw dull grey-brown rock with a rough pitted surface inside. Everywhere else, including his chest, the cooled black lava rock is unbroken and whole, and his face, ears and neck are living skin.
RIGHT Pose: both hands clasped behind his lower back, shoulders back, one foot crossed in front of the other.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme platform combat boots in black leather, the thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole, with his legs and ankles staying solid carved cooled black lava rock right down to the boots.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
